Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. +"""Keeps a project's live episodes numbered 1, 2, 3... with no gaps or repeats."""
+from typing import List, Optional
+from uuid import UUID
+
+from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+from app.models import Episode, Project
+
+
+def renumber_episodes(
+    session: Session,
+    project_id: UUID,
+    new_episode: Optional[Episode] = None,
+    position: Optional[int] = None,
+) -> List[Episode]:
+    """Renumber the project's live episodes 1..n in their current order.
+
+    If `new_episode` is given it is placed at 1-based `position` (clamped to
+    the valid range; appended when `position` is None) and added to the
+    session. Locks the project row so concurrent reorders serialize on
+    databases that support it. The caller commits.
+    """
+    session.exec(select(Project).where(Project.id == project_id).with_for_update()).first()
+
+    episodes = list(session.exec(
+        select(Episode)
+        .where(Episode.project_id == project_id)
+        .where(Episode.deleted_at == None)  # noqa: E711
+        .order_by(Episode.episode_order, Episode.created_at, Episode.id)
+    ).all())
+
+    if new_episode is not None:
+        episodes = [e for e in episodes if e.id != new_episode.id]
+        index = len(episodes) if position is None else min(max(position, 1), len(episodes) + 1) - 1
+        episodes.insert(index, new_episode)
+
+    for i, ep in enumerate(episodes, start=1):
+        if ep.episode_order != i:
+            ep.episode_order = i
+            session.add(ep)
+    if new_episode is not None:
+        session.add(new_episode)
+    return episodes

+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def _project(client, h, title="P"):
+    return client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": title, "genres": []}).json()["id"]
+
+
+def _add(client, h, pid, title, order):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": title, "project_id": pid, "episode_order": order})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _orders(client, h, pid):
+    listed = client.get("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, params={"project_id": pid}).json()
+    return [(e["title"], e["episode_order"]) for e in listed]
+
+
+def _abcd(client, h):
+    pid = _project(client, h)
+    eps = {t: _add(client, h, pid, t, i) for i, t in enumerate("ABCD", start=1)}
+    return pid, eps
+
+
+def test_restore_brings_episode_back_at_its_place(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, eps = _abcd(client, h)
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eps['B']['id']}", headers=h)
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("A", 1), ("C", 2), ("D", 3)]
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eps['B']['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.json()["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert r.json()["title"] == "B"
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("A", 1), ("B", 2), ("C", 3), ("D", 4)]
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eps['B']['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 200
+
+
+def test_restore_brings_back_the_cuts(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, eps = _abcd(client, h)
+    eid = eps["C"]["id"]
+    for i, script in enumerate(["one", "two"], start=1):
+        client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json={
+            "episode_id": eid, "cut_order": i, "script": script, "image_path": f"cuts/x/{i}.png",
+        })
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}", headers=h)
+    assert client.get("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, params={"episode_id": eid}).json() == []
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.json()["first_cut_image"].endswith("cuts/x/1.png")
+    cuts = client.get("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, params={"episode_id": eid}).json()
+    assert [c["script"] for c in cuts] == ["one", "two"]
+
+
+def test_restore_first_and_last(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, eps = _abcd(client, h)
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eps['A']['id']}", headers=h)
+    client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eps['A']['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("A", 1), ("B", 2), ("C", 3), ("D", 4)]
+
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eps['D']['id']}", headers=h)
+    client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eps['D']['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("A", 1), ("B", 2), ("C", 3), ("D", 4)]
+
+
+def test_undoing_several_deletes_in_reverse_order(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, eps = _abcd(client, h)
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eps['B']['id']}", headers=h)
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eps['C']['id']}", headers=h)
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("A", 1), ("D", 2)]
+    client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eps['C']['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eps['B']['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("A", 1), ("B", 2), ("C", 3), ("D", 4)]
+
+
+def test_restore_after_project_shrank_appends(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, eps = _abcd(client, h)
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eps['D']['id']}", headers=h)
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eps['C']['id']}", headers=h)
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eps['B']['id']}", headers=h)
+    client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eps['D']['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("A", 1), ("D", 2)]
+
+
+def test_restoring_a_live_episode_changes_nothing(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, eps = _abcd(client, h)
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eps['B']['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+    assert r.json()["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("A", 1), ("B", 2), ("C", 3), ("D", 4)]
+
+
+def test_restore_is_hidden_from_non_members(client):
+    owner = signup(client)
+    pid, eps = _abcd(client, owner)
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eps['B']['id']}", headers=owner)
+    stranger = signup(client, email="stranger@example.com")
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eps['B']['id']}/restore", headers=stranger)
+    assert r.status_code == 404
+    r_missing = client.post("/api/v1/episodes/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/restore", headers=stranger)
+    assert r_missing.status_code == 404
+    assert r.json() == r_missing.json()
+    # Still deleted.
+    assert _orders(client, owner, pid) == [("A", 1), ("C", 2), ("D", 3)]
+
+
+def test_restore_requires_auth(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    _, eps = _abcd(client, h)
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eps['A']['id']}/restore").status_code == 401
